title: mRemoteNG Portable External Tools %DISK-FLASH%
author: LESHIY-ODESSA
body_snippet:
How do I specify the path to a program in External Tools that is located in another folder higher up the tree, and the drive letter is unknown?

~~C:\Programs Files\WinSCP\WinSCP.exe~~

FLASH-DRIVE\UTILS\mRemoteNG\mRemoteNG.exe
FLASH-DRIVE\UTILS\WinSCP\WinSCP.exe ➜ External Tools ➜ Working directory ???

From a local drive, I configured it like this: C:\UTILS\mRemoteNG\WinSCP\WinSCP.exe ➜ File name — `.\!-WinSCP\WinSCP.exe`
